title: 18″ Gear Premium 7mm Sidekick Beaker Bong
description: The 7 mm Sidekick Beaker from Gear Premium stands at 18 inches tall with a beaker base design. Wearing 24K gold decals for premium look, the beaker is also set up with a beautifully designed, patent pending built-in lighter holster to store a lighter for ultimate convenience. Packing with extra accessories, the Sidekick will offer unforgettable experiences to users.
